Regulation: B.C. Reg. 147/2026
Made under: Utilities Commission Act
Published in: No. 14 – B.C. Regs. 125 to 148, July 28, 2026
Deposit date: July 24, 2026

B.C. Reg. 147/2026, deposited July 24, 2026, under theUTILITIES COMMISSION ACT[section 3]. Order in Council 360/2026, approved and ordered July 24, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that Direction No. 5 to the British Columbia Utilities Commission, B.C. Reg. 245/2013, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — A. DIX,Minister of Energy and Climate Solutions; J. WICKENS,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Section 1 of Direction No. 5 to the British Columbia Utilities Commission, B.C. Reg. 245/2013, is amended (a)	by repealing the definition of"CNG", (b)	in paragraph (b) of the definition of"CNG service"by striking out "CNG" and substituting "compressed natural gas", (c)	in the definition of"expansion facilities"by striking out "owned and operated" and substituting "operated and owned or leased", (d)	by adding the following definition: "first nation"includes a person authorized to act on behalf of Indigenous peoples who hold rights recognized and affirmed by section 35 of theConstitution Act, 1982;, (e)	by repealing the definition of"LNG agreement", (f)	in paragraph (f) of the definition of"LNG service"by adding "and marine LNG service" after "including LNG dispensing service", (g)	by repealing the definition of"long-term LNG service", (h)	by adding the following definitions: "marine LNG rate schedule"means the utility’s Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) and Renewable LNG (RLNG) Sales, Transport, Dispensing and Jetty Service Rate Schedule 48 set out in Appendix 6 attached to this direction; "marine LNG revenue deficiency regulatory account"means an account to capture the first 10 annual variances between (a)	the forecast cost of service in relation to marine LNG service, and (b)	the forecast revenues in relation to that service under the marine LNG rate schedule that are used by the commission in setting rates for applicable customers; "marine LNG service"means any service referred to in section 3, 4, 5, 6 or 9 of the marine LNG rate schedule; "marine LNG variance regulatory account"means an account to capture the following variances: (a)	the first 10 annual variances between the forecast cost of service in relation to marine LNG service and the actual cost of service in relation to that service;

minutes_briefs.title: BC Amends BCUC Direction No. 5 to Add Marine LNG Service Rules and First Nation Definition
minutes_briefs.summary: BC Regulation 147/2026, deposited July 24, 2026, amends Direction No. 5 to the British Columbia Utilities Commission (the provincial body that sets utility rates). The changes add new definitions for 'marine LNG service' (liquefied natural gas services like sales, transport, dispensing and jetty service under Rate Schedule 48), create two regulatory accounts to track variances between forecast and actual costs and revenues for marine LNG service, broaden the 'expansion facilities' definition to include leased facilities, and add a definition of 'first nation' that includes people authorized to act on behalf of Indigenous peoples with section 35 rights.
